btcmaxis.name: bitcoin maxis
btcmaxis.tldr: the only sound money; everything else is noise
btcmaxis.ontology: Sound money is the base layer of civilization; Bitcoin is the only credibly neutral monetary substrate — everything else on this map is fiat, noise, or a scam.

topics.d: Bitcoin sank to $63,000 on July 28 as an Asian chip-stock crash spilled into Wall Street and the US Senate shelved the Clarity Act ahead of the Fed decision.
Michael Saylor's Strategy skipped its bitcoin buy for a fifth straight week on July 27, adding $525 million to cash reserves instead of stacking BTC.
Saylor declared on July 28 that Bitcoin's code is 'a constitution' and that proposed BIP-110 changes are attacks on holders' economic rights, reigniting Core politics.
US spot bitcoin ETFs shed $465 million over the two days into July 27, led by BlackRock's IBIT.

ethereum.name: ethereum
ethereum.tldr: credibly neutral protocols; the world computer
ethereum.ontology: Reality is programmable coordination; credibly neutral protocols are how humanity scales trust. The world computer settles everything else on this map eventually.

topics.d: Morgan Stanley launched Ethereum and Solana ETFs on July 28 with the market's lowest fee at 0.14% plus staking rewards, following its bitcoin fund's success.
Tom Lee's Bitmine kept buying Ether and is now approaching 5% of all Ethereum supply with an $11.8 billion treasury as of July 27.
Lido kicked off a staking overhaul on July 27-28 — reported as a $16 billion migration — with an upgrade that aims to cut Ethereum's validator count by one-third.
Ethereum's layer-2 ecosystem is losing momentum, with L2 total value locked dropping to a two-year low per The Block on July 28.

solana.name: solana
solana.tldr: one global state machine, as fast as light allows
solana.ontology: Speed is the feature and the market is the test; one global state machine, block by 400-millisecond block. Increase bandwidth, reduce latency.

topics.d: Morgan Stanley launched the market's cheapest Solana ETF with staking rewards on July 28, after its bitcoin fund topped $381 million.
Blockaid's July 28 report says Solana passed Arbitrum for second-highest hack losses in H1 2026, driven mostly by key compromises.
SOL slipped below $75 on July 28 as traders rotated into ETH, with chartists still calling for a breakout back toward $90.

stablecoins.name: the stablecoin economy
stablecoins.tldr: the dollar won crypto; crypto won the dollar's rails
stablecoins.ontology: The dollar won crypto and crypto won the dollar's rails; the stablecoin is the internet's checking account, and regulation is the moat.

topics.d: Circle bought nearly 1,000 blockchain patents from IBM on July 27, making the USDC issuer America's biggest blockchain patent holder.
Samsung said on July 24 that Samsung Wallet will add native stablecoin support including USDC, putting dollar tokens on Galaxy phones worldwide.
PayPal expanded its stablecoin push in its July 28 Q2 earnings, with crypto assets now a factor in the payment giant's results.
Tether's XAUt gold token received Shariah certification on July 27, opening the tokenized-gold product to Islamic finance markets.

rwa.name: tokenized tradfi
rwa.ontology: Every asset — treasuries, gold, credit, houses — migrates on-chain eventually; the blockchain is the back office of the next financial system.

Ondo US Dollar Yield — rank #39, $2.1B market cap, $1.14.

Janus Henderson Anemoy Treasury Fund — rank #72, $871M market cap, $1.11.
Invesco Short Duration US Government Securities Fund — rank #74, $833M market cap, $11.16.
Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund — rank #84, $687M market cap, $1.04.

topics.d: Tokenized stock trading jumped fivefold on Robinhood Chain, Decrypt reported July 27, as onchain equities set records across venues.
Ondo scrapped its layer-1 blockchain plan on July 27 and launched the offchain Ondo Network, days after its Oasis Pro unit won FINRA authorization for tokenized US stocks.
Securitize's Capital unit became an SEC-registered investment adviser on July 27, adding regulated plumbing under Wall Street's tokenized funds.
Kraken opened the Jersey Mike's IPO to retail investors on July 28 through tokenized shares and direct allocations.

exchangetokens.name: the exchange empires
exchangetokens.tldr: the casino always wins; own the house
exchangetokens.ontology: Flow is the moat and the listing is the favor; whatever the cycle does, the house collects the fee. Own the house.

topics.d: BitMEX and BitMart both moved to wind down this week — CoinDesk on July 28 called them the first casualties of the crypto trading slump as volumes consolidate onto Binance and OKX.
A new report covered July 28 says Binance makes fighting crypto crime more difficult, with police complaining the exchange slows their tracking of scammers.
Binance co-founder CZ came out on July 28 for crypto license passporting across ASEAN, so one country's license would work across the region.
The Binance app disappeared from Google Play in certain EU countries on July 27, per Cointelegraph.

xrparmy.name: the xrp army
xrparmy.ontology: The banks will settle on our rails and the lawsuit was proof of importance; patience is the strategy and the standard is coming.

topics.d: XRP slid on July 28 after the US Senate shelved the CLARITY market-structure bill, the regulation the army was counting on, right before the Fed decision.
Ripple launched Ripple Mint and added Notabene compliance support for RLUSD on July 24, even as the stablecoin's transfer volume fell 25%.
S&P Dow Jones and Pantera launched an 18-coin crypto index on July 22 led by Ethereum, BNB, Solana and Tron, and XRP holders fumed that XRP was left out.

oldguard.name: the old guard L1s
oldguard.tldr: the tech was never the problem
oldguard.ontology: The roadmaps were right, the peer review was real, and the market is a popularity contest; the tech was never the problem. Ecosystems outlive cycles.

topics.d: Tron landed in S&P Dow Jones and Pantera's first crypto index on July 21-22, picked as a top revenue-generating protocol while Bitcoin and XRP were excluded.
Cardano sidechain token NIGHT rebounded 19% on July 22 after the Wanchain bridge hack, with Charles Hoskinson urging the industry to dump legacy bridges.
Cardano platform SecondFi announced on July 22 it is shutting down after a $2.4 million ADA wallet theft blamed on transaction-signing software.

privacy.name: privacy coins
privacy.tldr: cash was private; money should be again
privacy.ontology: Financial privacy is a human right, surveillance is the default, and the only cash left is the kind they cannot see. The original cypherpunk errand.

topics.d: Zcash activated its Ironwood upgrade on July 28, retiring the Orchard shielded pool after a counterfeiting-risk bug and sealing a $1.7 billion shielded pool.
Monero jumped 10% on July 25 and pushed at $400 resistance as traders bet the privacy-coin trade that lifted ZEC into the top 15 is rotating to XMR.
DCG's Zcash mining arm Fortitude powered up a Nebraska facility on July 28 and is eyeing a public listing, a sign of institutional money behind ZEC.

l2s.name: the L2 archipelago
l2s.ontology: Blockspace scales in layers: inherit Ethereum's security, compress the cost, and the rollup becomes the city where people actually live.

topics.d: Robinhood's new Arbitrum-built chain topped Base in daily users on July 23 — driven by memecoins, not tokenized stocks — after racking up 100M transactions in weeks.
The Arbitrum Foundation asked for a $43M budget for 2027 on July 22, the same day a 'Fast Feed' proposal would route 97% of revenue to the DAO treasury.
Mantle moved $2.5B of MNT to Chainlink's CCIP, part of a $7B migration triggered by a $650M wave of bridge hacks, CryptoSlate reported July 26.
Ethereum L2s now hold $37.4B in TVL led by Base, Arbitrum and Optimism (July 23), while L2 transaction fees have fallen 95%.

linkmarines.name: the link marines
linkmarines.tldr: the oracle is the truth layer
linkmarines.ontology: Smart contracts are blind without oracles; whoever feeds the chain the world's data is the truth layer of everything built on it.

topics.d: After roughly $650M in bridge hacks, over $7B in tokens from Mantle, KelpDAO, Lombard, Kraken and others migrated to Chainlink CCIP in Q2, CryptoSlate reported July 26.
Chainlink co-founder Sergey Nazarov was appointed to the CFTC's Innovation Advisory Committee on July 22.
Whales accumulated over 14M LINK with the price holding near $8.54, including a single $13.2M buy of 1.58M LINK reported July 27.
COIN stock rose on July 25 after Coinbase deepened its DeFi strategy with a Chainlink integration.

newl1s.name: the new L1 frontier
newl1s.tldr: the next chain will be the fast one
newl1s.ontology: Every cycle mints a new fastest chain and a new believer class; throughput is destiny and migration is always one killer app away.

topics.d: Toncoin jumped 36% around July 25 on news Telegram is taking over the TON chain, folding the network tighter into the app.
Pavel Durov announced Telegram's 'largest rollout' of non-custodial crypto wallets to over 1 billion users on July 21, lifting the renamed Gram token 7%.
Pi Network fell 10% to about $0.083 on July 24 as token unlocks and whale selling loomed, just after the protocol v25 upgrade went live.

aicoins.name: the AI coins
aicoins.ontology: Intelligence is becoming the world's largest market and it must not be owned by five companies; tokens are how compute, models, and identity stay open.

topics.d: Sam Altman's World Foundation raised $52.5 million on July 24 in a Pantera-led deal, selling locked WLD to fund World ID human-verification tech.
Grayscale filed an S-1 on July 21 for the first US Worldcoin ETF, extending its ETF lineup beyond Bitcoin and Ether.
MEXC and Yuma launched Bittensor TAO staking on July 23 while traders watched TAO test $220 resistance after network upgrades.

defi.name: defi
defi.ontology: Finance is being rebuilt as open programmable infrastructure; lending, trading, and yield without permission — the protocols outlive their founders.

discussing.d: World Liberty Financial — rank #45, $1.7B market cap, $0.0549.

topics.d: Restaking protocol KelpDAO was exploited for $292M, and even after Arbitrum froze $71.2M in ETH the hacker moved another $175M by July 25.
Three crypto bridge hacks in one day on July 23 erased $35.6M — led by AFX's $24M — pushing July's total hack losses toward $100M.
WEMIX and Garden were both hacked around July 27, adding to what trackers are calling a record year for crypto breaches in 2026.
Lending protocol Morpho surpassed $3B in deposits on July 26, a rare growth story in an exploit-heavy DeFi week.

memecoins.name: the trenches
memecoins.ontology: Attention is the only real asset and price is the only truth; the coin is the community and the sin is not playing but exiting late.

discussing.d: 币安人生 (BinanceLife) — rank #88, $632M market cap, $0.6324.

topics.d: PUMP surged 15% on July 27 as BOOST-mode buybacks absorbed vesting supply, with pump.fun printing over $1.17M revenue in 24 hours after overtaking TRON and Hyperliquid in daily revenue on July 23.
Dogecoin fell 5% on July 24 after Elon Musk said he 'got carried away' with politics, leaving DOGE grinding near its yearly low.
Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev's X account was hacked on July 23 to shill a fake VLAD memecoin, and the exploiter made about $1.2M before the posts came down.

degenperps.name: the perp casinos
degenperps.ontology: The market is a 24/7 casino and the only honest venue is one that cannot close; leverage is a right and the funding rate is the weather.

topics.d: Perp DEX volumes hit a nine-month low in July (reported July 25), and CryptoRank noted on July 27 that only one perp DEX grew volume this month — and it wasn't Hyperliquid.
Arbitrum perp DEX AFX Trade lost $24.15M in USDC on July 23 after its bridge keys were compromised, then offered the hacker 30% to return the rest.
Tom Lee hailed Lighter as a key Ethereum L2 exchange on July 27, citing $43B of trading volume in 30 days, as Lighter completed a 16M LIT buyback and kicked off quarterly burns.
dYdX shipped Chain v5.1 on July 23, opening the door to permissionless market listings, while its community's new Arcus DEX brought tokenized stock trading to Robinhood Chain.

fiat.name: the fiat ocean
fiat.tldr: the water every coin defines itself against
fiat.ontology: State money — not an island but the water: the unit of account, the exit everyone prices in, the default every tribe on this map defines itself against. It doesn't feel like a system for the same reason water doesn't feel wet.

topics.d: The Fed announces rates Wednesday July 29, and prediction-market traders spent July 27 bracing for a surprise rate hike.
Korea's Kospi plunged 10% on July 28 as an AI chip-stock crash spread through markets, knocking bitcoin down 2% after the US close.
The yen fell back to 40-year lows against the US dollar on July 28 as markets eye the Bank of Japan's meeting on Friday.
CoinDesk wrote July 27 that bitcoin shrugged off the AI stock selloff but the high-stakes Fed meeting could determine what happens next for crypto.

hyperliquid.name: hyperliquid
hyperliquid.ontology: One chain, one orderbook, no VCs: the exchange belongs onchain and to its users. The airdrop was the proof and HYPE is the deed.

topics.d: HYPE slid below $60 the week of July 22 after Multicoin unstaked $120M and institutions pulled $291M, with funds queuing roughly $150M more of locked tokens for withdrawal.
Hyperliquid's SK Hynix stock futures flash-crashed to $927 on July 28 and set off a liquidation cascade, days after the exchange promised automated refunds for an API outage.
Hyperliquid opened a $29M DeFi Policy Center in Washington DC on July 23 and, with Multicoin, pushed the CFTC toward a single prediction-market rulebook on July 28.
Bitwise moved closer to a Hyperliquid ETF launch with a second SEC filing on July 27, while Grayscale dropped Coinbase for Anchorage as custodian of its own HYPE ETF on July 22.

regens.name: regens & public goods
regens.ontology: Value is regenerative, not extractive: public goods are the real wealth, and crypto's purpose is coordination infrastructure that funds what markets and states won't.

topics.d: Kevin Owocki's July 14 temp check proposes a small paid 'transitionary stewards' cohort (Aug 2026-Aug 2027) to oversee Gitcoin's pivot from Ethereum-native grants toward real-world local funding, drawing pushback on scope and pay through July 26.
A July 21 RFC on the Optimism forum asks for $15,000 to build a 'Capital Efficiency Oracle' that audits Season 9 OP grant recipients for Sybil-farmed TVL before Season 10 allocation votes.

Celo mainnet swapped its execution client from op-geth to op-reth on July 22, deepening its OP Stack alignment, and the core team warned node operators that op-geth nodes will no longer follow the chain.

nft.name: nft land
nft.tldr: the jpeg was never the point
nft.ontology: Ownership is the primitive: art, identity, and game economies belong to their holders. The jpeg was never the point; the community deed was.

topics.d: Pudgy Penguins landed Pengu plushies in over 1,800 US Target stores on July 19 — its biggest retail push yet — with 5% of net merch revenue flowing to NFT holders and PENGU popping 4.6% on the news.
Bored Ape Yacht Club's Discord was hacked on July 24, capping a week in which CoinMarketCap reported dozens of NFTs stolen and holders traded 'STAY SAFE' warnings.
APE surged to a 3-month high over the July 24-27 weekend, with Stocktwits reporting one whale netting a $700,000 profit on the move before pullback chatter set in.

depin.name: depin
depin.ontology: Networks of real hardware — wireless, compute, sensors — bootstrap themselves with tokens instead of capex; the crowd builds the infrastructure the telcos would not.

topics.d: Decentralized-storage pioneer Storj Labs filed for Chapter 11 around July 25-27, with The Block headlining a roughly 20% STORJ drop and BeInCrypto asking what's left for token holders.
Crypto.com delists Helium Mobile's MOBILE token on July 28 and is supporting a swap into HNT, the latest step in Helium folding its subtokens into a single-token economy.
SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce confirmed on July 21 that the agency issued a no-action letter for a decentralized-energy DePIN project, read across the sector as a friendlier regulatory stance.

artists.name: the onchain artists
artists.tldr: the culture organizes in person; the chain keeps the receipts
artists.ontology: The art was always the point: provenance, patronage, and scenes that organize in person — galleries, residencies, city by city. The market is downstream of the culture, not the other way around.

topics.d: Christie's held its ninth annual Art + Tech Summit in New York the week of July 26, gathering artists, collectors, and tech leaders around AI, tokenization, and digital ownership, while Deadfellaz launched its free God Pull mint for holders on July 27.
The first mint of punk6529's 6529 Network Museum, a platform for showcasing digital art through NFTs, went live around July 26 and drew notable collector attention.
SuperRare announced Loss of Language by artist ttiimmees, a set of 100 unique portraits priced at 0.02 ETH each, dropping on the platform August 3.
